title: Enchantment
description: Technology-neutral definition of an enchantment in GUMFALL. Enchantments interact with the Overmatch formula and body-region ward system. Malady-type enchantments are separately flagged and carry hard restrictions on crafting, duplication, and rerolling.

id.description: Unique identifier for this enchantment. Use kebab-case.

category.description: Functional category of this enchantment. Malady subtypes (Omnislayer, Ruin, Affliction, Finality) are represented via the malady flag and malady_subtype field.

malady_subtype.description: VERIFIED Malady subtypes. Only present when malady is true. Cannot be crafted, duplicated, rerolled, or receive a fifth enchantment.

pressure_value.description: Enchantment Pressure used in the Overmatch formula: Overmatch = Enchantment Pressure − Ward Strength. Higher pressure means the enchantment overcomes wards more easily.

rank_multiplier.description: VERIFIED rank multiplier reference. Standard ×1, Veteran ×1.5, Elite ×3, Champion ×6, Boss ×12, Mythic ×25. Minions do not roll enchantments.

eligible_weapon_families.description: Weapon families this enchantment can appear on. Empty array means unrestricted (all families eligible).

malady.description: VERIFIED: true if this enchantment is a Malady type. Maladies cannot be crafted, duplicated, rerolled, or coexist with a fifth enchantment on an item.

buildup_reduction_interaction.description: VERIFIED: How this enchantment's buildup interacts with the Overmatch formula buildup reduction bands.

overmatch_minus_15_or_lower.description: 80% buildup reduction when Overmatch is −15 or lower.

overmatch_above_plus_20_note.description: Above +20 Overmatch the effect is not prevented but duration is reduced by 10%.

effect_description.description: Mechanical description of what this enchantment does when active.

description.description: Plain-text lore and design description of this enchantment.

notes.description: Internal design notes, authority labels, or open questions.

eligible_weapon_families.description: Malady enchantments are not craftable onto weapons — this field records families on which they can naturally appear.
